# YM54: 福海 Fu Hai, "The Happy Sea"

Wave 1 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM54` · Page: `/scenes/#YM54` · Row: `research/buildings/YM54-fu-hai/`

## What it was

福海 Fu Hai, the Sea of Blessings, also called the East Lake 东湖, is the largest water of the garden, 'some qing round' (周廣凡數頃, S05 j82:14a), roughly square and almost half a mile a side by Malone, joined by a narrow opening to the lake before 方壶胜境 (S02 p.93, E2370). Eight of the Forty Scenes stand on its shores and islands (scenes 30-37, E2370): 澡身浴德 in the south-west corner with 澄虚榭 facing east, 望瀛洲 north of it, 平湖秋月 in the north-west corner, 接秀山房 on the east facing west, 别有洞天, 夹镜鸣琴, 涵虚朗鉴 on the east, 蓬岛瑶台 in the middle (S05 j82:14a-22a). Yongzheng took princes and ministers boating and fishing here on festival days (S205, E2364); under Qianlong the dragon-boat race was held on it with painted boats and music, the emperor in 望瀛洲, his mother on 蓬岛瑶台 (S205 E2363; S202 j14, E1889). Attiret describes boats for air, fishing and water jousts, and fireworks and illuminations on the water (E2368). In October 1860 the minister in charge 文丰 Wen Feng is said to have drowned himself in one of the lakes after the gate fell (S02 p.185, E2369).

From the inventory row: **destroyed** n/a (water) (S05, S02, S01).

## Interior and setting

### Interior

Nothing written yet.

### The garden around it

Attiret saw an island palace on a rock about six feet above the water, quays of stone or rockwork, palaces in tiers and groves round the shore, aviaries half in the water and a fish reservoir closed with brass wire (S157, E2366, E2367). The 1744 prefaces give low ridges and green islets (接秀山房: 平岡縈迴碧沚停蓄), 'bamboo isles and reed banks' with ducks and herons (澡身浴德: 竹嶼蘆汀 ... 浴鳬飛鷺), and the Western Hills seen across the water (S05 j82:14b, 18a).
